name: NLR Alternative Fuels Data Center - Alt Fuel Stations API
license: NLR Developer Network Terms and Conditions - data may be used for any purpose; no DOE/NLR/Alliance endorsement; provided as-is; indemnification and liability terms apply
notes: Filter fuel_type=ELEC for EV-only. Structured GeoJSON source; Curator should ingest deterministically rather than use LLM extraction.

name: EIA US Energy Atlas - Petroleum Refineries
baseUrl: https://atlas.eia.gov/datasets/eia::petroleum-refineries-1/explore (Esri Feature Service; static shapefile also at https://www.eia.gov/maps/map_data/Petroleum_Refineries_US_EIA.zip)
format: Esri Feature Service (REST, queryable as GeoJSON) or Shapefile snapshot
license: US federal government work (public domain) - EIA
notes: Periodic EIA snapshot, not real-time. Prefer the Feature Service endpoint over the shapefile for fetch_structured. Covers the fossil fuel refineries seed topic (2.2).

name: Voting Information Project (VIP) / Democracy Works polling place data
baseUrl: https://www.votinginfoproject.org/ (VIP spec: https://vip-specification.readthedocs.io/) - alt: Google Civic Information API (https://developers.google.com/civic-information)
format: VIP XML/CSV feeds aggregated per state by Democracy Works; no single federal bulk API
license: Varies by contributing state election office; generally public data
geography: US, coverage varies by state and is strongest close to election dates
notes: Not a single reliable bulk endpoint - aggregates per-state feeds that activate mainly around elections. Treat coverage gaps as expected; if a state has no active feed, skip it rather than falling back to unstructured search for polling addresses (sensitive/volatile data). Covers the voting/polling locations seed topic (2.2).

name: Overture Maps Foundation - Places dataset
baseUrl: https://docs.overturemaps.org/getting-data/ (GeoParquet via AWS S3 open data or the overturemaps CLI)
notes: Already the decided source for the second 10 maps (2.7). Filter category=theme_park for the theme-parks seed topic (2.2) - covers multi-state chains (Six Flags, Cedar Fair, etc.) as individual POIs; Curator groups by operator name.

name: United States Parachute Association - Find a Drop Zone
format: HTML directory/listing - no public bulk API, but each entry is a structured, consistent record (name, address, contact)
license: USPA site content - no explicit open license found; attribute to USPA and verify terms before publishing
notes: Borderline case: authoritative membership directory, but scraped rather than a real API. Curator should only mark records sourceClass=managed if the extracted fields stay structured/consistent per listing; if it degrades into narrative extraction, mark unmanaged instead. Covers the skydiving-dropzone half of the motocross/skydiving seed topic (2.2).

name: data.gov CKAN API (federal open-data catalog)
format: CKAN REST API (JSON); individual datasets link out to CSV/GeoJSON/Shapefile
license: Varies per dataset - mostly public domain or CC0, check per result
notes: A search index across many agencies, not a data source itself - each result still needs its own license check before use. General-purpose fallback for the 5 'existing open-data map files' topics (2.2), Curator's choice.

name: ArcGIS Hub / Open Data (Esri)
baseUrl: https://hub.arcgis.com (federated search across per-org Esri Feature Services, e.g. opendata.arcgis.com)
format: Esri Feature Service (REST, queryable as GeoJSON)
license: Varies per publishing organization - check per dataset
notes: Best fit for state/local-government-published topics (some counties publish their own polling-place or facility layers here directly). General-purpose fallback for the 5 'existing open-data map files' topics (2.2), Curator's choice.
